top_signals.title: Oil Prices Volatile as Supply Disruptions Hit Four Global Fronts
top_signals.summary: Brent futures surged past $100 a barrel as the conflict in the Middle East widens and Ukraine strikes Russian infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Wall Street Bulls Are Staring Down $100 Oil, Tariffs, AI Angst
top_signals.summary: Every bull market has a recurring cast of villains. Oil shocks. Inflation. Rising bond yields. Trade wars. This week, investors had to contend with all of them at once.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Miner Cadillac, Backers Raise C$385 Million in Canada IPO
top_signals.summary: Cadillac Mines Corp. and some of its backers raised C$385 million ($273 million) in an upsized initial public offering, adding to the mining-driven rebound of listing activity in Canada.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
